ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a nitrogen-containing bridged-ring skeleton, with a nitrogen atom at the upper left, and a methyl group attached to the nitrogen; this nitrogen participates in a bicyclic amine framework. A carboxylic acid substituent is attached to the lower-left position of the ring, labeled as HO2C. On the upper right side there is a carboxylic acid/carbonyl fragment, and on the lower right side there is also a carbonyl oxygen; the curved arrows in the figure indicate transition-state electron movement, ignore them according to the problem statement. Reasoning: According to the specified writing method, starting from the methyl on the nitrogen gives CN. The nitrogen is numbered as a ring atom, and the bicyclic amine skeleton can be written as N1C2CCC1. Continuing along the ring to connect the carbon bearing the carboxylic acid substituent, it is written as C(C(=O)O); then connect the intraring ketone carbonyl fragment C(=O); subsequently pass through C2 with ring closure, and connect the second carboxylic acid C(=O)O on that carbon. Therefore, the SMILES matching the structure in the figure is CN1C2CCC1C(C(=O)O)C(=O)C2C(=O)O.

method.method_draft: Describe the molecular graph from the image first, discarding the reaction arrows. Choose the methyl attached to nitrogen as the SMILES start, write CN, then encode the bicyclic amine framework with ring closures as N1C2CCC1... . Continue around the ring, adding the lower-left carboxylic acid substituent as C(C(=O)O), the ring ketone as C(=O), then close through C2 and attach the second carboxylic acid as C(=O)O. This gives the matching SMILES: CN1C2CCC1C(C(=O)O)C(=O)C2C(=O)O.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个含氮桥环骨架，左上有一个氮原子，氮上连有一个甲基；该氮参与一个双环胺框架。环的下左位置连有一个羧酸取代基，标作 HO2C。右上侧有一个羧酸/羰基片段，右下侧还有一个羰基氧；图中的弯箭头表示过渡态电子移动，按题意忽略。推理：按指定写法从氮上的甲基开始为 CN。氮作为环原子编号，双环胺骨架可写成 N1C2CCC1。继续沿环连接带羧酸取代基的碳，写作 C(C(=O)O)；再接环内酮羰基片段 C(=O)；随后经过带 ring closure 的 C2，并在该碳上连接第二个羧酸 C(=O)O。因此匹配图中结构的 SMILES 为 CN1C2CCC1C(C(=O)O)C(=O)C2C(=O)O。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the line-angle structure while ignoring all curved arrows: an N-methyl bridgehead tertiary amine on the left, a fused bicyclic carbon skeleton, one carboxylic acid substituent at the lower left labeled HO2C, one carboxylic acid group at the upper/right carbonyl-OH, and one ketone carbonyl at the lower/right part of the ring.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression for the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard skeletal-structure-to-SMILES rules: unlabeled vertices are carbons, heteroatoms are written explicitly, hydrogens on carbon are implicit, carboxylic acid is C(=O)O, ketone is C(=O), and ring closures are encoded with matching digits.
